title: Toy Boom: Squishies and Bricks
story: Toy stores are super busy because everyone wants squishy toys and building blocks. Kids love these toys, and they are flying off the shelves!
storyBig: The toy industry is experiencing a significant surge due to high demand for squishy toys and building blocks. These popular items are boosting sales and sparking debates over traditional versus tech-connected play.

bull: Playing with toys is more fun than ever!

title: Apps & Games Go Glitchy!
story: A big computer problem made many apps and games stop working for a while. The tech team is trying hard to fix it so everyone can play again soon.
storyBig: The tech industry faced a significant disruption as a major service outage affected multiple applications and games. Efforts are underway to address the technical issues and restore normal operations.
think: How do apps and games work on computers?
bull: Tech teams are working quickly to fix things.
bear: It might take some time for all apps to work again.
